It is derived from the Arabic root ز-ف-ن, which means to beautify, to adorn, and to make something beautiful. In Islamic tradition, Zafaan is associated with the concept of Taqwa, or righteousness, and is seen as a name that represents the highest level of moral excellence. The name is also mentioned in the Quran, where it is described as a name that is pleasing to Allah. Zafaan is a popular name in many Muslim cultures, and is often given to babies born into families who value beauty, joy, and spiritual perfection.
